research_findings: Within-capture known-attack evaluation produced high classification performance.
Source-separated experiments exposed poor generalization to some unseen attacks.
Day 16 showed many missed DDoS attacks received very low ATTACK scores.
Increasing XGBoost complexity provided negligible within-capture improvement.
The reported evaluations do not establish live-network or production performance.
limitations: Experiments used different training data and model configurations.
Within-capture splits may contain related flows.
Source-file separation does not guarantee independent network sessions.
Some configurations were selected using the reported validation datasets.
The project has not been evaluated on independent live network traffic.
